name: card
title: Card
description: A person's thing on a raised plate: media (on top, or square at the start), title, a corner action, a line, actions; regular or compact; a status LED; waiting on its own edge. A card with a link lifts one grid step on the settle spring as its shadow grows; a card that goes nowhere is still. A choice card latches down with the icon key's green LED. The frame holds cards: a sunk tray of peers, one plate of sections, or no tray, with an empty slot where a new card will go.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/card.md. SwiftUI: MetalCard in the MetalUI Swift package.
